name: Osananajimi to no Saikai, Soshite...
original_name: 幼馴染との再会、そして…
source:
My friend Taka fell in love at first sight with Kanata, a childhood friend I had been separated from when we moved away when we were little.
Overwhelmed by the unexpected reunion, I completely forgot about Taka.
According to Taka's plan, Kanata...
Time passed, and I thought I had forgotten.
But it came back to haunt me again, in the form of a nightmare.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ206722.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
我的朋友隆对遥一见钟情。遥是我儿时的青梅竹马，我们小时候搬家后便失去了联系。
意外重逢让我不知所措，完全忘记了隆。
按照隆的计划，遥……

时间流逝，我以为自己已经忘记。
然而，这段记忆又以噩梦的形式回来纠缠我。

（译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ206722.html]DLsite[/url]）
